title: Show a card
summary: An Ionic card groups a title and related content.
introduction: An Ionic card groups a title and related content. Your task: Change the card to describe a hobby.
learningObjectives: Change the card to describe a hobby.
Explain the example for show a card

blocks.text: An Ionic card groups a title and related content. It works well for a single book or short notice.
Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.

blocks.code:
import {IonApp,IonPage,IonHeader,IonToolbar,IonTitle,IonContent,IonCard,IonCardHeader,IonCardTitle,IonCardContent} from "@ionic/react";
export default function App(){return <IonApp><IonPage><IonHeader><IonToolbar><IonTitle>Reading club</IonTitle></IonToolbar></IonHeader><IonContent className="ion-padding"><IonCard><IonCardHeader><IonCardTitle>Book of the week</IonCardTitle></IonCardHeader><IonCardContent>A story about a moon garden.</IonCardContent></IonCard></IonContent></IonPage></IonApp>;}

blocks.text: The page shows one styled card with a heading and description.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A card is a visual group, not automatically a button. Use an actual control for actions.
